stem.text: Two people push a vertical gate to open it. The forces exerted by the people on the gate are shown.

stem.alt: Horizontal gate hinged at its left end, labelled hinge. Two forces are drawn as arrows at angles to the gate: F1 at angle θ1 and F2 at angle θ2. Distances d1 and d2 are marked from the hinge along the gate, and the gate is labelled gate.

stem.text: One person is distance $d_1$ from the gate's hinge and pushes with horizontal force $F_1$ at angle $\theta_1$ to the gate.
The other person is at distance $d_2$ from the hinge and pushes with horizontal force $F_2$ at an angle $\theta_2$ to the gate.
What is the total moment about the hinge due to forces $F_1$ and $F_2$?
